scope.historical_provenance_policy: Original P6 batch records and line/hash anchors are unchanged; this file adds current disposition and regression evidence without re-anchoring findings.

findings.disposition: W13 uses the result-aware FishingEngine path and does not render engine failure as numeric stretch zero; legacy scalar compatibility remains unchanged.
W13 free-point UI retains result status and does not present legacy failure zero as a measured depth.
W13 back-off UI retains result status and does not present legacy failure zero as a measured depth.

The existing missing-pipe screening fallback and stale-result save protection remain visibly labeled and regression-tested. Whether the fallback remains available or is refused without geometry still requires the domain owner.

No mud-ledger runway policy was changed. The source evidence explicitly records a legacy zero-consumption rule and requests an owner decision; W7 fuel/water semantics are domain-specific and do not by themselves authorize changing mud-chemical policy.
Nozzle optimization returns friction-exponent provenance and W13 labels the assumed n=1.0 fallback without changing the numerical optimization.

Cement and casing forms visibly identify untouched database NULLs, highlight placeholder controls, preserve untouched NULL on save, and allow explicit zero to remain numeric. No baseline default was promoted to a source fact.
findings.local_environment: Qt assertions not run locally because libGL.so.1 is unavailable; real-Qt exact-HEAD CI is required.

findings.disposition: W7 well/report switching clears stale inventory controls to unknown stock and zero movement.
W3c well/section switching clears stale section forms and scopes cement/casing load and save to the selected section.
W13 landing-load UI uses result-aware buoyancy and explicit unknown inputs; a failed result is not fed downstream as a successful zero.

The canonical BitPerformanceEngine now computes bit revolutions from required RPM bounds and hours; W3 inputs start as Not recorded, missing/failed calculations clear the derived display and persist NULL, while explicit zero and valid positive results round-trip.
findings.fault_injection: The UI regression injects a failed calculation after a successful 13.2 k.rev result and requires the display/payload to return to NOT ASSESSED/None.
findings.local_environment: Pure engine cases ran locally; real-Qt persistence test is blocked locally by missing libGL.so.1 and requires exact-HEAD CI.

findings.disposition: Missing/nonpositive/nonfinite completion OD no longer receives a fabricated engineering-scale width. A fixed-size, depth-positioned glyph explicitly says OD not recorded and symbol not to scale; the manual completion dialog also starts OD as Not recorded. Owner preference for showing versus omitting such a marker remains open.
findings.local_environment: Real Qt raster assertions are blocked locally by missing libGL.so.1 and require exact-HEAD CI.

findings.disposition: Malformed or missing legacy time strings remain visibly invalid; no synthetic 08:00/16:00 fallback is generated, and invalid intervals are rejected before replacement save.
Annular velocity requires a unique pipe OD associated with the current report/well scope; missing, invalid, ambiguous, or failed inputs remain NOT ASSESSED/NULL.

Stored legacy/source inventory remains separate and is no longer overwritten by Received minus Consumed. A distinct movement field is calculated only when both source movements are recorded, explicitly excludes backload, and is labeled not a closing stock balance. No opening/closing-stock formula was invented.
findings.open_owner_decision: Whether a true closing balance should include opening stock/backload and how historical imported on_hand should participate remains undefined by the current model.

findings.disposition: SafetyValidator has no in-repository caller and its last_rams_test branch remains a no-op. The active SafetyWidget has its own configured interval and NOT ASSESSED behavior. No new interval contract or wiring was invented.

EOWR cost query failure is represented as unavailable (None/query-failed), successful empty results remain available/no-records, and cost status is explicit in HTML and Excel Summary. Non-cost EOWR output continues as before; whether a future consumer requires whole-report failure remains an owner contract question.
findings.fault_injection: The test injects an exception only for CostRecord.query and checks collected status, HTML, and exported workbook Summary.

findings.disposition: Hierarchy refreshes coalesce to one pending latest-generation read, stale results are ignored, cancellation never terminates/detaches active synchronous database work, and window close defers until QThread.finished.
findings.fault_injection: A barrier-controlled slow DB fake issues repeated refresh requests and asserts maximum concurrent calls is one and only the latest result renders.
findings.local_environment: Real QThread test is blocked locally by missing libGL.so.1 and requires exact-HEAD CI.

findings.disposition: W10 and the linked W12 sibling now select a shared Agg adapter that renders into a real QWidget; raw FigureCanvasAgg is never passed to Qt layouts. Interactive Matplotlib callbacks are not part of this raster fallback.
findings.fault_injection: The canvas selector is tested with an injected ImportError for the Qt backend, then the returned widget is inserted in a real Qt layout and raster output is asserted.
findings.local_environment: Real Qt widget assertion is blocked locally by missing libGL.so.1 and requires exact-HEAD CI.
